description: Quad AD: four attack-decay envelope generators that can be chained into one another, built for percussive sounds

params.text: Sets how long that envelope takes to climb to full.
Sets how long that envelope takes to fall back to zero; in AR mode it is the release time, taken once the gate falls.
Switches that envelope between digital and analogue curve behaviour.
Sets the shape of that attack stage: faster, standard or slower.
Sets the shape of that decay stage: faster, standard or slower.
Switches that envelope between attack-decay, which ignores the gate length, and attack-sustain-release, which holds while the gate is high.
Chains the end of that envelope to the attack of the next one: Off, On, or Cycle, which keeps the chain running on its own.
Adds that envelope into the output of the next one.
Modulation depth for one of the four modulation inputs into the knob it belongs to; the figure is the shift a plus or minus 10V signal produces.

inputs.text: A trigger starts that envelope; held high in AR mode it holds the sustain.
Carries a modulation signal; arm it with its button, then turn a knob to set how far this signal moves that knob.

notes: A modulation input does nothing until you press the button above it to arm it and then drag a knob; the drag sets how far that input moves that knob, and a ring on the knob shows the amount.
menu: Attack Starts from Zero — starts a retriggered attack at zero even when the envelope has not finished.
Attack Starts from Current — starts a retriggered attack from the level the envelope had reached.
Use Global Style — ties this module's appearance to the setting shared by every Surge XT module, rather than to this module alone.
Skin — sets the panel colouring: Dark, Medium or Light.
Colors — a submenu setting the colour of the Display Area, Knob and Slider Values, Modulations and Power Buttons, and carrying Show Knob Shadows.
Value Displays — a submenu carrying Knob Value Rings, Knob Modulation Animations and Display Modulation Animations.
